_meta.ptally/summary: Reads a stretch of a project document around a passage the search found, so a clause can be read in full.
_meta.swallow/summary: Reads a stretch of a project document around a passage the search found, so a clause can be read in full.

description: Read consecutive passages of an indexed document: the passage numbered `chunk` (a search_docs result's chunk) plus `before` and `after` passages either side (default 1 each, max 10). Use it when a search hit is cut off mid-clause, refers to another clause, or uses a defined term you need to read. Returns `{ document: { document_reference, title, filename, pages, chunk_count, status, … }, from, to, chunks: [{ chunk, page, section, text }] }`. chunk 0 with a larger `after` reads a document from the start. A document that isn't indexed yet is a tool error. Nothing is changed.

after.description: Optional. Passages after it to include, default 1.

before.description: Optional. Passages before it to include, default 1.

chunk.description: Optional. The passage to read around: a search_docs result's chunk. Default 0 (the start).

document_reference.description: The document, from a search_docs result or get_project's documents.

name: get_doc
title: Read a project document
